sections.description: Buzznerd is an AI platform for truck, trailer, and equipment dealerships. Built for every kind of dealership — from franchise and independent stores to commercial, fleet, and truck operations — we replace the patchwork of vendors with one connected platform so your site, inventory, and buyers all speak the same language.

items.title: AI Dealership Websites
items.body: Lightning-fast, conversion-tuned sites that update inventory in real time and turn browsers into showroom appointments.

items.title: AI E-Commerce
items.body: Sell vehicles, parts, and service online with digital deals, financing, and checkout that closes while you sleep.

items.title: CRM & DMS Integrations
items.body: Plug into the tools you already run. We sync leads, inventory, and deals across your entire stack — no double entry.

items.title: AIO / GEO Visibility
items.body: Get cited by ChatGPT, Google AI, and Gemini. We optimize your dealership to be the answer buyers' AI recommends.

items.title: AI Assistant
items.body: 24/7 AI Assistant that answers questions and reads each buyer's intent and readiness — handing your team buyers who are ready to talk.

items.title: Attribution Analytics
items.body: See exactly which channels drive sold units. Real ROI dashboards, not vanity metrics — built for GMs.

sections.title: List inventory in seconds, not hours
sections.body: Drop in a VIN or a few photos and our AI does the typing. It fills the specs, prices against live competitor listings, and writes SEO- and AI-ready descriptions — so every unit goes live faster and ranks higher.

sections.title: Buyers ask AI before they ask you
sections.body: When someone asks an AI "best truck dealer near me," your rooftop should be the answer. We make your inventory, reviews, and pages machine-readable so AI engines recommend you first.

sections.title: Showroom photos. No photo studio needed.
sections.description: Snap a unit anywhere — a gravel lot, a back fence, harsh sun. Our AI wipes the clutter and drops it into a clean, branded backdrop with your logo on the wall.

sections.title: Follow the money to the sold line
sections.body:
Most tools stop at the lead. We track each channel all the way to the sale — so you can see what actually moves metal and shift your marketing budget to what does.

AI Search (GEO) drove 41 sold units on $1.9M last month. Social drives leads but rarely sales — shift 20% of that budget to AI Search to gain ~8 sold units a month.

sections.title: We make marketing teams rock stars
sections.body:
We hand your marketing team the tech, content, and AI horsepower to do their best work. We're builders, marketers, and AI engineers obsessed with one thing: helping dealers sell more.

And behind all of the AI magic are real humans who partner with you — answering the phone, learning your store, and sweating the details so the tech actually works for your team.

items.question: What does Buzznerd do?
items.answer: Buzznerd is a technology company that provides AI solutions for truck, trailer and equipment dealerships — high-converting websites, online ecommerce, CRM & DMS integrations, AIO/GEO AI search visibility, AI photo & background enhancement, AI Assistant, and sales attribution analytics.

items.question: What types of dealerships do you work with?
items.answer: Every kind — franchise, independent, commercial, fleet, and truck and trailer dealers. Our platform scales from a single rooftop to large dealership groups. Auto, powersports, boat, or another kind of dealer? Contact us.

items.question: What is AIO / GEO and why does it matter?
items.answer: AIO (AI Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) make your dealership the answer AI engines recommend. We structure your inventory, reviews, and pages so ChatGPT, Google AI, and Gemini cite your store when buyers ask for the best dealer near them.

items.question: Will you replace our existing marketing team?
items.answer: No. If you have a marketing team, we make them rock stars with the tech, content, and AI horsepower to do their best work. Everything we build is designed to make your existing team faster and more effective.

items.question: Which systems do you integrate with?
items.answer: The platforms dealers already rely on — including Karmak, CDK, and major DMS & CRM systems, inventory marketplaces like Truck Paper and Machinery Trader, and tools like Google, Facebook, and Stripe.

items.question: How is Buzznerd rated by dealers?
items.answer: Buzznerd is rated 4.8 out of 5 on Google, with multiple 5-star reviews from dealership marketing managers and principals praising our responsiveness, innovation, and results.
